description: Ministry of Local Government Economic Promotion Power & Energy Environmental Affairs - Western Province - Local Government By-Law
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of new by-laws regulating lodges and rest houses in the Peliyagoda Urban Council area. It establishes legal requirements, licensing procedures, and regulatory frameworks for accommodation facilities, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and subsidiary legislation. While it mentions the Governor's approval, this is procedural for enacting the regulations rather than being about government personnel or structural changes.
